name: Gift
text: Triggers when the card is summoned.

name: Last Words
text: Triggers when the creature or structure is destroyed.

name: Production
text: Triggers at the start of each of its owner's turns.

name: Combat
text: Triggers whenever it exchanges attacks with creatures, structures or the enemy orb (not when shot by a ranged creature).

name: Corrupt
text: Triggers the first time this creature moves onto enemy land, on a turn after it was played.

name: Activate
text: Structures only: use the ability once per turn.

name: Flying
text: Can move over ocean and land, but not through creatures or structures.

name: Charge
text: Can move several spaces in a straight line.

name: Jump
text: Moves up to two tiles and can leap over obstacles, creatures and ocean.

name: Taunt
text: Adjacent enemy creatures cannot move and can only attack the taunt.

name: Dash
text: When summoned, moves X spaces in a straight line.

name: Haste
text: Can move, attack and harvest the turn it is played.

name: Protection
text: Prevents all damage from the next damage source, then is removed.

name: Discover
text: Creates a copy of a card.

name: Ranged Attack
text: Shoots in a straight line with line of sight; takes no retaliation unless adjacent or shot by another ranged unit; cannot attack after moving normally.

name: Divine
text: Cannot be targeted by spells or abilities from either player (still attackable and hit by area effects).

name: Aquatic
text: Can only travel over lakes and ocean; drowns at end of turn on other land.

name: Swallow
text: Removes a creature from the game until the swallower dies, then releases it.
